Example Genotype-by-Environment BLUE Table

Source: R/example_data.R
gs_example_blues_gxe.Rd

Simulated stage-1 BLUEs for 120 genotypes in three environments for `gblup_cv_gxe.R`. The simulation contains environment mean effects and moderate genotype-by-environment reranking. Some observed rows contain only `SE` or only `Weight`, and six cells have no phenotype or precision value so that prediction-only rows are represented. Every genotype remains observed in at least two environments.

Usage

gs_example_blues_gxe

Format

A data frame with 360 rows and six columns:

GenoID

Genotype identifier.

Env

Environment (`E1`, `E2`, or `E3`).

NBL

Simulated stage-1 BLUE; `NA` for prediction-only cells.

Population

Stable genotype-level stratum (`P1` to `P3`).

SE

Standard error, possibly missing when `Weight` is present.

Weight

Precision weight, possibly missing when `SE` is present.

Source

Generated by `data-raw/generate_example_data.R`.

Examples

data(gs_example_blues_gxe)
with(gs_example_blues_gxe, table(Env, is.na(NBL)))
#>     
#> Env  FALSE TRUE
#>   E1   119    1
#>   E2   117    3
#>   E3   118    2
with(gs_example_blues_gxe, table(Population, Env))
#>           Env
#> Population E1 E2 E3
#>         P1 40 40 40
#>         P2 40 40 40
#>         P3 40 40 40
